item.title: IAEA’s politicized use of safeguards undermines its impartiality: Russian envoy
item.description: Russia’s Ulyanov says the IAEA is becoming increasingly partial in its dealings with countries like Iran.

item.title: Iran, Afghanistan discuss expanding trade, customs operations
item.description: Agriculture minister puts bilateral trade at $2.7 billion and proposes deeper Iranian involvement in Afghan production chains.

item.title: 3D printing, reverse engineering, AI usher Iran into sophisticated manufacturing
item.description: In Qazvin, an advanced manufacturing ecosystem combining reverse engineering, metal 3D printing, artificial intelligence, and university research is opening new frontiers for Iran's domestic production of sophisticated industrial components and equipment.

item.title: IRGC warns France against Israel's 'false-flag trap’ to turn Europe against Iran
item.description: The IRGC says that, unlike the US and Israel, civilians are not among the elite military force's targets.

item.title: Hezbollah: Iran proved ‘US is no longer a superpower’
item.description: Iran has exposed the limits of Washington’s military and political power in its confrontation with the US-Israeli axis, the Hezbollah official says.

item.title: Count your chickens first, then talk about winter: CBI chief to Bessent
item.description: CBI governor dismisses new US sanctions threats as premature, saying nearly $33 billion in foreign currency has been supplied.

item.title: IRGC: Two violating tankers catch fire after striking mines on unauthorized route in Hormuz
item.description: The IRGC Navy’s Public Relations said the vessels had deactivated their navigation and automatic identification systems and were trying to pass covertly via a prohibited southern corridor.

item.title: Tehran: US rewrites history to dodge blame for illegal war on Iran
item.description: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson said Washington is desperately trying to evade responsibility for the “catastrophic human, economic, and geopolitical consequences” of its unlawful aggression against the Islamic Republic.

item.title: US admits it is committing war crimes, economic terrorism against Iran: FM spokesperson
item.description: Iran says the US blockade threat against Iran amounts to an admission of pursuing war crimes and threatening to starve the Iranian people.

item.title: IRGC shoots down 17th US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island
item.description: The IRGC reports a growing number of US reconnaissance and combat drones destroyed by its air defense systems, including MQ-1 and MQ-9 models.

item.title: Task Force Iron Gate: Why US cannot seal Iran’s land trade routes
item.description: Iran's neighbors are lining up to expand trade and transportation ties with Tehran even as the US unveils Task Force Iron Gate, seeking to restrict Iran's land-based commerce and economic connections.

item.title: Rosatom to increase personnel at Iran’s Bushehr nuclear plant to 300: CEO
item.description: The announcement comes months after the Russian state-owned nuclear corporation evacuated hundreds of staff following the US-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: Czechs gather in huge numbers to say no to government's plan to overhaul funding of public media
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of people rallied in Prague on Sunday against a plan by the government of Czech billionaire Andrej Babiš to overhaul funding for public broadcasters.

item.title: 'Trump, you are not welcome': Protesters clash with police in Manila
item.description: Protesters clash with police as they attempt to access roads leading to the ASEAN summit venue in Manila.

item.title: Mourners gather in northern Gaza for vigil honoring 70 people killed during war
item.description: Mourners gathered in northern Gaza on Saturday evening for a vigil honoring 70 people who were killed during the war.
